fact: Leonard Nimoy based the Vulcan salute on a Jewish blessing he remembered seeing as a boy.

hook: the guest star had been to space.
fact: Astronaut Mae Jemison appeared in The Next Generation's Second Chances after her real shuttle mission.
Nichelle Nichols helped NASA recruit women and minority astronauts for the Space Shuttle program.
A fan letter-writing campaign helped get NASA's first space shuttle orbiter named Enterprise.

hook: Kirk was wearing green all along.
fact: Kirk's famous gold command tunic was actually avocado green. Studio lighting and film stock helped turn its color yellow on television.
NASA astronauts Terry Virts and Mike Fincke made guest appearances in the Enterprise finale.
